clue.text: Act about a change of rate where two parties are involved

indicators.note: about means the word for an act goes around the other pieces

parts.note: an act of Parliament starts life as a bill
taken as written

indicators.note: a change of the word rate means its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Something is done about a rate rise in a deal between two sides.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Act' looks like a verb but is the noun: a parliamentary bill, which goes 'about' the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A bilateral agreement or treaty is one made between exactly two sides.

clue.text: The mischievous fellow one and all censure

parts.note: an imp is a mischievous little devil, or a naughty child
each, like one and all, covers every single member of a group

explanation.surface: A naughty boy and everyone else get told off.
explanation.definitionFit: To impeach is to accuse or charge formally, a form of official condemnation.

clue.text: It's hard for a queen ant

definitions.note: the definition is a noun phrase: a legendary substance of great hardness

parts.note: taken as written
a dam is a mother animal, as a queen is a breeding female cat or bee
taken as written

explanation.surface: Life is tough for the queen of an ant colony.
explanation.walkthrough: Adamant is also a noun: an imagined stone too hard to break, hence 'It's hard'.
explanation.definitionFit: Adamant was the name of a mythical unbreakable stone, so it is something very hard.

clue.text: Rowing men accepting agreement makes sense

indicators.note: accepting means the crew word takes the other word inside it

parts.note: an eight is a racing boat with eight oarsmen
yes is a word of agreement

explanation.surface: A rowing crew that can agree shows good judgement.
explanation.definitionFit: Sight is one of the five senses, and eyesight is that faculty.

clue.text: Push off to get some food about one

indicators.note: about means the meal word is placed around the other piece

parts.note: lunch is a midday meal
a means one, as in a single thing

explanation.surface: Someone leaves to go and grab a bite.
explanation.definitionFit: To launch a boat is to shove it off into the water.

clue.text: Tests ales that may well be flat

indicators.note: that may well be suggests the letters given could be something else once rearranged

explanation.surface: A taster checks beers that could have gone flat.
explanation.definitionFit: Flat food or drink has lost its savour, so it lacks flavour.

clue.text: An artist's house many live in

definitions.note: read as 'An artist is', the 's joining the definition to its wordplay

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty, a large number
to be is to live or exist
taken as written

explanation.surface: A painter's home is shared by many residents.
explanation.walkthrough: 'artist's' reads as 'artist is'. Holbein was a German-born painter at Henry VIII's court.
explanation.definitionFit: Hans Holbein the Younger was a Renaissance portrait painter.

clue.text: Cleaning block, squire?

parts.note: to deter is to block or discourage
a squire is a gentleman, shortened to gent

explanation.surface: A landed gentleman is asked about his cleaning session.
explanation.definitionFit: A detergent substance is one used for washing things clean.

clue.text: Only a sea-going man will get sea-ear

parts.note: AB, able-bodied seaman, is a sailor
alone means only, as in he alone knew

explanation.surface: Only a sailor will catch this shellfish.
explanation.definitionFit: The sea-ear is another name for this edible shellfish, from the shape of its shell.

clue.text: Pop in a pair the Spanish wear

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: in means the father word goes inside the pair abbreviation

parts.note: pop and pa are both words for father
el is the Spanish word for the

explanation.surface: Dad tries on a couple of things worn in Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: Wear as a noun means clothing, as in evening wear.

clue.text: Remarkable absence of basic furniture

parts.note: no, as in no food, signals that something is missing
a table is one of the most basic items of furniture

explanation.surface: A room with no table is noticeably empty.
explanation.definitionFit: Something notable is worth noticing, so striking or outstanding.

clue.text: Patricia's devious, living at others' expense

indicators.note: devious means winding or crooked, so the letters take a twisted route

explanation.surface: Patricia is sly and sponges off other people.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's counts here: all nine letters of PATRICIAS are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A parasite feeds off a host, so parasitic means sponging off others.

clue.text: To separate is nothing new!

parts.note: taken as written
O is the shape of zero, nothing
late means recent, as in the latest news

explanation.surface: Someone protests that splitting things up is old news.
explanation.definitionFit: To isolate something is to set it apart from others.

clue.text: Give voice about the underworld using explosives

indicators.note: about means the singing word wraps around the other piece

parts.note: to sing is to give voice to a song
hell is the underworld of the damned

explanation.surface: Someone sings about Hades while setting off bombs.
explanation.definitionFit: Shelling is an attack by firing explosive shells.

clue.text: Most hatcheries provide waterproof cover

indicators.note: provide says the two words supply the answer from within their letters

explanation.surface: Fish hatcheries are typically given a weatherproof roof.
explanation.definitionFit: A thatched roof of straw or reed keeps rain out of a building.

clue.text: Indulgence shown towards poor cleaner

parts.note: to means towards, as in walk to the shop

indicators.note: poor suggests the word cleaner is badly formed and needs reworking

explanation.surface: An employer puts up with a cleaner who does a bad job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shown' is only a link; 'poor' marks the cleaner's letters for rearranging.
explanation.definitionFit: Indulgence and tolerance both mean allowing behaviour without objecting.

clue.text: Best friend will get around it admirably

indicators.note: will get around means the two joined words surround the other piece

parts.note: to cap is to outdo or best someone
an ally is a friend or supporter
taken as written

explanation.surface: A close friend handles a problem with great skill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Best' is a verb here, not part of 'best friend'.
explanation.definitionFit: Capitally is a dated British word for excellently.

clue.text: Making no gains, as a lot's gone wrong

indicators.note: gone wrong suggests the letters before it have been put in the wrong order

explanation.surface: A business shows no profit because so much has failed.
explanation.definitionFit: Selling at a loss means receiving less than cost, so earning nothing.

clue.text: Lumbering tot included in cast

indicators.note: included in means the adding word sits inside the throwing word

parts.note: to cast and to sling both mean to throw
to tot up is to add

explanation.surface: A clumsy child appears in the cast of a play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lumbering' means burdening (lumbering someone with a job), not moving clumsily.
explanation.definitionFit: Lumbering someone with a task is loading them with it, just as saddling them is.

clue.text: Quite out-of-the-ordinary place is crumbling

indicators.note: crumbling means falling to pieces, so the letters before it are broken up and reset

explanation.surface: A remarkable old building is falling apart.
explanation.definitionFit: Something special is exceptional, unlike the usual.

clue.text: Comply when told to go

parts.note: as means when, as in as I left
someone sent away has been told to go

explanation.surface: A servant obeys when ordered to leave.
explanation.definitionFit: To assent is to agree or go along with a request.

clue.text: Everybody in newly-formed side went on the attack

indicators.note: in means the whole-group word is placed inside the other letters
newly-formed means the letters of side are put into a new shape

parts.note: all means everybody

explanation.surface: A freshly assembled team charges forward together.
explanation.walkthrough: 'side' reads as a team in the surface, but it is just four letters to be reshaped.
explanation.definitionFit: To sally is to rush out against an enemy, as besieged troops did.

clue.text: Falls back once more before gunmen

indicators.note: back means the word for once more is read in the backward direction

parts.note: again means once more
RA, the Royal Artillery, is the British Army's gunnery regiment

explanation.surface: Someone retreats again in front of armed men.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Falls' looks like a verb but is the definition, the waterfall; 'before' just puts the gunmen last.
explanation.definitionFit: Niagara is the famous waterfall on the US-Canada border.

clue.text: Former coppers allowed to be blunt

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife
coppers are pennies, abbreviated P
licit means lawful or permitted

explanation.surface: Retired police officers are permitted to speak frankly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coppers' are copper coins, British pennies, not police.
explanation.definitionFit: An explicit statement is plain and direct, leaving nothing unsaid.

clue.text: Some claim particular accord

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Part of a specific claim is about reaching agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: To accord someone something is to grant or bestow it, to give it.

clue.text: Males made fast retreat concerning theory of inheritance

parts.note: men are males

indicators.note: retreat means go back, so the word for made fast is read backwards

parts.note: nailed means fixed firmly in place

explanation.surface: Men quickly withdrew from a discussion of heredity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fast' means firmly fixed, not quick; 'retreat' turns NAILED into DELIAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Gregor Mendel's laws describe how traits are passed between generations.

clue.text: A right to fix high-level lighting

parts.note: taken as written
to clamp is to fix firmly

explanation.surface: Someone claims the right to install overhead lights.
explanation.definitionFit: An arc lamp gives intense light from an electric spark, used for floodlighting.

clue.text: Corresponding just the same

explanation.definitionFit: Corresponding things match or resemble each other; things alike are nearly the same.

clue.text: The swimmer who's a toady?

explanation.definitionFit: A swimmer doing front crawl; also a fawning flatterer who creeps to superiors.

clue.text: A person taking part ending disastrously

definitions.text: A person taking part ending disastrously

parts.words: A person taking part ending disastrously
parts.note: taking a part is acting a role, and a play ending in disaster is a tragedy

explanation.definitionFit: A tragedian is an actor in tragic drama, plays which end in catastrophe.
